finding.rationale: The Section 9.11 definition of "Material Adverse Effect" opens with a present-effect prong ("has a material adverse effect") and includes a forward-looking prong using "would (or would reasonably be expected to)" — the "would (reasonably) be expected to" standard. The "could" phrasing does not appear in the definition.

finding.rationale: Section 6.9(a) imposes a 'reasonable best efforts' standard on Boston Private regarding its agents, advisors and representatives' compliance with no-shop obligations. This reasonable standard applies to non-officer/director representatives, distinguishing them from the strict obligation imposed directly on officers and directors.
